1.

What grace, O Christ, it is indeed, That now we are one With Thee, who such great love hast prepared For Thine own.

2.

By grace alone for our sake Thou didst come down to earth, Becamest partaker of flesh and blood, And for our sin didst suffer here.

3.

Our bill of debt Thou didst in love take And upon the cross didst bear; Thou didst drain the cup of wrath for us, And thus hast set us free.

4.

Our Head now in heaven For us Thou sittest there; Neither life, nor death, nor depth, nor height Shall ever separate us from Thee.

5.

Teach us to understand and testify here Of the wonder that has come to pass, That we on earth yet with Thee In heaven are one.

6.

Soon comes the day of glory With all Thou hast prepared for us, When Thou for all wilt show That we with Thee are one!
